tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for joining the study. Today, I'd like to ask you some questions about your commuting habits. First, is it important to live close to your school or work? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你参与本次调查。今天我想问你一些关于通勤习惯的问题。首先，住在离学校或工作单位近的地方重要吗？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Imagine that you could choose to commute by car, which is faster but more expensive,or by public transportation, which is slower but less expensive. Which would you choose, and why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。设想一下，你可以选择开车通勤 —— 速度更快，但费用更高；或者选择公共交通 —— 速度慢一些，但更便宜。你会选哪一种，为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Some people believe that commuting can be stressful and tiring. What do you think are one or two different ways to make commuting more enjoyable? Give reasons for your answer.
tasks.analysis: 中文：挺有意思的。有些人觉得通勤既紧张又疲惫。你认为有哪一两种方法可以让通勤变得更愉快？请说明理由。
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Lastly, considering advances in technology, some people believe that commuting might disappear entirely. How do you think a severe decline in commuting might affect businesses in positive ways and negative ways? Please give one example of each.
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得很有道理。最后，考虑到科技的发展，有些人认为通勤可能会完全消失。你认为通勤大幅减少可能会对企业产生哪些积极影响和消极影响？请各举一个例子说明。
tasks.title: Interview
